Eternamax Eternatus Returns

Sat, Nov 21, 2026, 11:00 AM → Sat, Nov 21, 2026, 2:00 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

Eternamax Eternatus is back at most Power Spots for three hours (11 a.m.–2 p.m. local) on Saturday, Nov 21, as part of Dynamax Trails.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

What to know

  • Eternamax Eternatus can't be caught; the catchable Eternatus is a reward on GO Pass: Dynamax Trails.
  • Most Power Spots host it during the window, so nearby spots should have other players to team up with.

Tip

Pawniard Community Day starts right after (2–5 p.m. local), so you can do both on the same afternoon.
